Source formula: 1{FE ≥ 0 and ADJFE < 0}; FE = (actual EPS − median forecast) / beginning-of-year stock price; ADJFE = NDEPS − median forecast; NDEPS = actual EPS − DA per share. Source definition: Indicator equal to one when forecast error (actual EPS minus the median consensus forecast, divided by beginning-of-fiscal-year stock price) is nonnegative while adjusted forecast error is negative. The paper specifies the median consensus forecast closest to the earnings announcement and I/B/E/S actual EPS from the Historical Summary tape for forecast-error calculations. ADJFE is NDEPS minus the median forecast; NDEPS equals actual EPS minus discretionary accruals per share (equivalently, cash flow from operations plus nondiscretionary accruals per share). Thus positive discretionary accruals allow the firm to cross the forecast threshold. Zero otherwise. implementation_issues.description: The article’s discretionary-accrual residual is asset-scaled, but its conversion to the per-share DA subtracted from actual EPS is not specified.
HORIZON is measured from earnings announcement to forecast month in the main-model definition but from fiscal year-end in the Table 2 note; the source does not reconcile them.
TENURE treats auditor mergers as continuation and BIGN changes across Big 8/6/5/4 eras; complete historical merger and auditor-code crosswalk is not supplied.
Industry fixed-effect count differs between the text (52 two-digit SIC industries) and Table 4 note (53 represented codes); the two-way cluster dimensions are also unnamed.
Forecast-data winsorization is reported for forecast-error calculations, but the article does not say whether it applies to the Table 4 MBE classification.
The estimator for the supporting annual two-digit-SIC/year Jones fits is not named; this is an implementation choice, not a missing raw-data source.

review_notes: For SHORT, Equation (3) specifies tenure >1 and <4, while the appendix says three years or less; first-year engagements are excluded, so the definitions agree within the retained sample.
HORIZON timing differs between the main model/Table 3 definition and the Table 2 descriptive note; use the main-model/Table 3 definition for this baseline and preserve the discrepancy.
The paper does not report the conversion from the asset-scaled Jones residual DA to the per-share discretionary accrual used in NDEPS.
Footnote 16 specifies forecast-data winsorization for forecast-error calculations; its application to Table 4 MBE is not clear, so it is not recorded as a setting applied to this equation.
Coverage remains undetermined without coordinator-supplied historical/population confirmations. Exact successful local field probes are reused; they establish columns only.
Table 4 retains both frozen model/result-set IDs and the shared Jones construction.

HORIZON is measured from earnings announcement to forecast month in the main-model definition but from fiscal year-end in the Table 2 note; the source does not reconcile them.
TENURE treats auditor mergers as continuation and BIGN changes across Big 8/6/5/4 eras; complete historical merger and auditor-code crosswalk is not supplied.
Industry fixed-effect count differs between the text (52 two-digit SIC industries) and Table 4 note (53 represented codes); the two-way cluster dimensions are also unnamed.
Forecast-data winsorization is reported for forecast-error calculations, but the article does not say whether it applies to the Table 4 MBE classification.
The estimator for the supporting annual two-digit-SIC/year Jones fits is not named; this is an implementation choice, not a missing raw-data source.
